obligation: extends G032 (channel scale) and the G033/G034 codec ranking to ATTENTION
why: Every function-space, transform, sensitivity and codec result this session was MLP-only, while attention is 34% of the artifact's addressed bytes. The mixer_x capture site existed and had never been used.
site_verified: mixer_x is labelled PER LAYER in the capture: deltanet layers carry 'deltanet_gated_recurrent_normed_out_proj_input' and every fourth layer carries 'gqa_softmax_gated_repeat_v_o_proj_input'. Both are 6144 wide and both matched the tensors' input dimension exactly, which is checked in code rather than assumed.
finding_1_codec_ranking_holds: q4 < q3 < q2 in output error on every attention tensor, the same ordering as MLP. Flat-code dominance is not an MLP artifact.
finding_2_attention_is_more_sensitive: q3 costs attention 0.228-0.301 output error against MLP's 0.198-0.240 at the same width, consistent with the campaign's standing note that attention sets the BPW floor.

finding_3_channel_scale_gains_MORE_on_de.note: a=0.25 against flat q3. L62's -34.92% is the LARGEST channel-scale gain measured anywhere this session, against roughly -18% on MLP. The shallow attention layers gain little and the deep ones gain a great deal, which is a stronger depth dependence than MLP showed.

consequence: g032-chanscale-a025-compact folds s and t on MLP ONLY. These numbers say the transform is worth MORE on deep attention than on the MLP it is currently applied to, and linear_attn is 2.954 GB of the 3.845 GB attention payload.
open_question_foldability: For MLP the fold was exact and free because diag(1/s) went into post_attention_layernorm. For deltanet out_proj there is a gated_rmsnorm immediately before it that could carry diag(1/s) the same way -- plausible but NOT verified. For GQA o_proj the input is a sigmoid-gated repeat of v and the fold path is not obvious. So the deltanet half (48 of 64 layers) is the tractable one and even that needs the algebra checked before it is claimed.
width: four tensors, two depths, one scheme family. a=0.5 is worse than a=0.25 on all four, matching MLP.
